settings.heading:
One bed.
Two answers.
settings.lede: Two mattresses, linked. Each side supported on its own, each comfort layer tailored separately. What suits one of you does not have to be what suits the other.

settings.heading: Why two
settings.body:
Two people rarely want the same bed. One sleeps hot, one is cold. One has a bad back, one has a bad shoulder. A single mattress makes that a negotiation, and somebody loses it every night for a decade.

Two halves. Two comfort layers. Neither of you compromises.

Each side is a complete mattress with its own pocket spring core and its own removable layer. After you have slept on it, you each tell us how your side should feel. We make two layers, to two descriptions.

settings.label: Two units, linked
settings.text: Joined along the inner edge so they behave as one bed and do not drift apart.

settings.label: One surface
settings.text: Dressed with a single fitted sheet. The join sits between you, not under either of you.

settings.label: Two answers
settings.text: Each layer is changed on its own. One of you can go softer without the other going with them.

settings.label: Up any staircase
settings.text: Each half rolls and boxes separately, so it reaches rooms a single large mattress cannot.

settings.heading: You do not choose the feel. You discover it.
settings.text: Feel is discovered over months of use. You have a year with us. We adjust it until it is.

settings.heading: It arrives finished.
settings.text: Concierged. Room of your choice. Unrolled onto your bed. The old one leaves with it.

settings.heading: It stays right for twenty five years.
settings.text: The part that softens renews. The part that lasts, lasts.

settings.heading:
A bed that becomes yours,
and stays that way.
Concierge unpacking
settings.text: Concierged. Room of your choice. Unboxed, unrolled, positioned. The packaging leaves with it. So does the old one.

settings.heading: Old mattress removal and recycling
settings.text: Taken away on the same visit. Nothing in the hall, nothing to arrange.

settings.heading: Nothing left behind
settings.text: Carton, plastic, wrap. All of it leaves with it.

settings.heading:
It arrives compressed.
We do not leave it that way.
settings.lede: Roll packing gets it up the stairs. It is not how it should be left.

settings.heading: Choose your size
settings.lede: You cannot know how a mattress feels in four minutes. So the feel is decided after a year, not before. Same 35cm construction, same removable comfort layer. Split King is two linked halves, 2 × 106 × 213cm.
